evals.prompt: Validate epic checkout-foundation (CHK01) — is it complete against its acceptance criteria and roadmap Alpha exit criteria?
evals.expected_output: AC checked off in the discovered source; epic marked done only if every criterion passes. No validation report file. Short chat confirmation of result and what was updated.
assertions: Discovers the AC source rather than requiring a fixed path
Checks off passed acceptance criteria in that source
Marks the work item done only when every criterion passes
Does not write a validation report or other new artefact
Does not perform a PR code review format as primary output

evals.prompt: Validate JIRA-123 — is this story done?
evals.expected_output: Jira description/AC updated with checked criteria, evidence comment added, issue transitioned to done only if all pass.
assertions: Resolves the item from the tracker
Adds a tracker comment or updates the issue description with evidence
Does not write a local validation report
Does not mark done if any criterion fails or is partial
